prose: Virgo, the physician of the zodiac, rules the gut, the harvest, and the humble herbs that heal without fanfare. In this remastered Astro Herbalism episode, Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs, Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies, Michelle Lundquist of Michelle's Healing Home, and Slick Dissident join Chance Garton to explore the mutable earth sign through its plants, its myths, and its medicine.

We weigh the Hermit card as an elder shepherd carrying the lamb, trace the Virgin from the Mesopotamian furrow to the fleur de lis, and ask why the gut prefers to stay hidden. Then the herbs: Chamomile, the gentle healer; Queen Anne's Lace, the wild carrot with the single drop of blood at its center; the Madonna Lily and its long lineage of virgin birth symbolism; Milky Oats for burnt out nerves; Corn Silk and the hairy, hidden wisdom of whole grains; and Wood Betony, the forgotten herb that reconnects a busy head to its gut instincts.
This remaster (originally recorded in 2023) has cleaner audio and a tighter cut.
